name: Seerr
desc: Find and request movies and shows for Plex

changes.summary: Safer sign-in, and fewer sign-in prompts
points: When the server rejects the session, Seerr signs in again only once
Server names use https by default, IP addresses and local names http - and you are warned when a sign-in would not be encrypted
Down and OK in an empty list no longer closes the app
